answer_1.quote: We demonstrate that LLMs can articulate visual knowledge of narrative scenes by inferring this knowledge directly from story text... LLMs are an effective interface for transforming story text into prompts that facilitate text-to-image models to produce illustrations.
answer_1.outputs: scene descriptions (captions), text prompts, evaluation criteria

answer_3.quote: We then enlisted visually-enabled models to assess illustrations based on this criteria. ... We utilized three VLMs that have obtained notable performance on visual understanding benchmarks: CLAUDE-3.5, GPT-4O, and PIXTRAL.

answer_4.quote: We deployed the task on Prolific to obtain annotators... In judging a pair, human annotators were shown the full story with the target fragment underlined, along with the two alternative images. Annotators were instructed to select the image that was "the better visualization of the underlined fragment".
answer_4.guideline: Select the image that better visualizes the underlined fragment; annotators could also choose "I can't decide".
